data_objects.name: dated_feature_vectors
data_objects.meaning: Identified records with an application date and a dense vector of one hundred anonymous numeric features.

variables.name: apply_date
variables.meaning: Application date encoded as YYYYDDMM: four-digit year, then two-digit day, then two-digit month.

variables.name: feature_1 … feature_100
variables.meaning: Dense family of one hundred anonymous continuous numeric features.

structure.description: Each row is one identified feature vector. feature_1 through feature_100 are ordered by their numeric suffix.

uncertainties: The meanings, units, scaling, and provenance of the one hundred features are not supplied.
annotation_notes: apply_date is not YYYYMMDD: values with a middle component above 12 are valid under the observed YYYYDDMM encoding.
The anonymous feature columns are grouped as a regular high-dimensional family.
